analysis.question: When the VIX spikes above 40, what happens over the following quarter? Characterize the decay profile and maximum drawdown from the spike peak.

event_definition.clustering: first close above 40 starts the event; consecutive closes above 40 are part of the same event; VIX must close below 40 at least once before a new event can begin

windows.method: row-index slicing over daily observations; day 0 is the spike day (first close above 40); retain missing-value rows for indexing, exclude from averages

quality_gates.golden_access: verification only — never read golden values during implementation; compute results independently, then verify
